_note: Tier-1 sweep batch 001, late August 2026: gGCKex1IOtE, F-CNFR1LQQI. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: In prayer he saw people grabbing for life vests as on a sinking Titanic, pulling others underwater to save themselves, and applied the image to the present economy.
mentions.quote: I saw people reaching for life vest like you see like a Titanic going down
mentions.falsify_match: Economic breakdown severe enough that people are widely reported turning on one another for scarce financial lifelines.
mentions.falsify_miss: The economy holds through the period he points at, with no such scramble.

mentions.claim_text: Crypto market-structure legislation aimed at 2026 could slip to 2027, but the SEC and CFTC stay more supportive than the previous administration, so the sector does well either way.
mentions.quote: for 2026 and could get delayed till 2027
mentions.condition_text: if the bill does not become law this year
mentions.falsify_match: Crypto market-structure law passes in 2026 or 2027 with regulators broadly supportive.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such law by the end of 2027, or regulators turn hostile.

mentions.claim_text: Camera networks tied to a federal database will flag people automatically, including immigration status, and the count of such cameras rose sharply from 2024 to 2026.
mentions.quote: it will alert the third authorities
mentions.falsify_match: Documented growth of camera-plus-database identification flagging individuals to authorities by end of 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such expansion or no automated alerting capability in that window.

mentions.claim_text: A blood moon falls two days from this recording and after it come major events, with September a time of great shakings.
mentions.quote: the blood moon happens then we have major events
mentions.time_phrase: after the blood moon, into September
mentions.falsify_match: Events widely read as major shakings cluster in September 2026 after the late-August blood moon.
mentions.falsify_miss: September 2026 passes as an ordinary month.

mentions.claim_text: Distractions resembling January 6th will run while cities are shaken all at one time, with the real action in the economy and in Canada.
mentions.quote: cities again that would happen all at one time
mentions.falsify_match: Simultaneous unrest across multiple US cities during a news cycle dominated by an unrelated spectacle.
mentions.falsify_miss: No multi-city simultaneous unrest of that kind.

mentions.claim_text: Fuel is rationed with limits on how much can be taken and both rich and poor queue for long periods; the situation is said to have improved by early August.
mentions.falsify_match: Documented fuel rationing with queues across income levels, easing in early August 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: No rationing or queues in that window.

mentions.claim_text: The first road bridge between Russia and North Korea is being finished and will be completed in September.
mentions.quote: When will they finish this bridge? September.
mentions.falsify_match: The Russia-North Korea road bridge opens or is reported complete in September 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: Completion slips past September 2026 or does not occur.

mentions.claim_text: A word given on 21 July 2025, thirteen months earlier, is now showing up in the news, alongside reporting of a ten million dollar bounty on a named figure.
mentions.quote: July the 21st of 2025 is when we saw it
mentions.falsify_match: A ten million dollar bounty on the named figure is confirmed in reporting around August 2026.

mentions.claim_text: In a vision around July he saw permission granted to dig deep at the Noah's ark site, uncovering petrified boards that appeared joined together.
mentions.quote: they would get permission to dig deep down and find
mentions.falsify_match: Excavation permits granted at the Ararat or Durupinar site and worked timber recovered.
mentions.falsify_miss: No permit, or no timber-like material recovered.

mentions.claim_text: He reads a US travel warning suspending Mexico operations over an unstated threat as the cartel uprisings and turf wars he described, with Claudia Sheinbaum losing control and being forced out of government.
mentions.quote: I saw Claudia losing control and she'll be drugged out
mentions.falsify_match: Cartel turf wars escalate and Sheinbaum loses office or effective control.
mentions.falsify_miss: Sheinbaum serves out her term with the state retaining control.
